verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Claude acting as an MCP client in two ways. Users can connect existing remote MCP servers, or build their own, as custom connectors, and claude.com advertises integrating any tool through connectors with remote MCP. Claude Desktop also installs local MCP servers 'as easily as browser extensions', and connectors can be found in a unified directory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that plugged-in MCP tools work in practice, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
